e.title: vinereg（D-藤 Copula 分位回归）
e.summary: D-藤 Copula 分位回归（CRAN 0.13.0）：参数/非参数 pair-copula，直接给出条件分位数
e.summary_en: D-vine copula quantile regression (CRAN 0.13.0): parametric or nonparametric pair-copulas yielding conditional quantiles directly
e.summary_hk: D-藤 Copula 分位回歸（CRAN 0.13.0）：參數/非參數 pair-copula，直接給出條件分位數
e.body:
vinereg（CRAN 0.13.0）实现 **D-藤 Copula 分位回归（D-vine quantile regression）**，配对函数可用参数或非参数 pair-copula，方法出自 Kraus & Czado (2017) 与 Schallhorn et al. (2017)；底层依赖 rvinecopulib、kde1d 与 Rcpp（含 RcppEigen/RcppThread/BH）。它的定位是：**不建模条件均值，而是直接给出条件分位数**，并且允许变量之间的相依结构随协变量变化。对 RIAA：保险定价与风险度量真正关心的往往不是均值而是**条件分位数**（VaR、分位定价、高分位情景），而普通线性分位回归在多变量、非线性、尾部相依的数据上不够用——vinereg 把藤 Copula 的灵活性直接接到分位回归上，适合变量多、相依结构复杂且需要向尾部外推的场景；它属于 VineCopula/rvinecopulib 的作者生态（Python 侧对应 [[pyvinecopulib]]），与 [[vinecopula-r]]、[[copula-r]]、[[simcop]] 构成 copula 工具链，与 [[insurance-copula]]、[[insurance-vine-longitudinal]]（纵向 vine copula）、[[insurance-quantile]]（分位方法）在方法上直接对接；适合作相依建模、尾部风险与分位定价方向。

## 同类工具
[[volrisk]]、[[wh-revisit]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
e.body_en:
vinereg (CRAN 0.13.0) implements **D-vine copula quantile regression**, with parametric or nonparametric pair-copulas, following Kraus & Czado (2017) and Schallhorn et al. (2017); it depends on rvinecopulib, kde1d and Rcpp (with RcppEigen/RcppThread/BH). Its positioning is precise: it does **not model the conditional mean but delivers conditional quantiles directly**, and it lets the dependence structure among variables vary with covariates. For RIAA: what insurance pricing and risk measurement actually care about is often a **conditional quantile** (VaR, quantile pricing, high-quantile scenarios), and ordinary linear quantile regression is insufficient on multivariate, non-linear data with tail dependence — vinereg wires the flexibility of vine copulas straight into quantile regression, suiting problems with many variables, complex dependence and a need to extrapolate into the tail; it belongs to the VineCopula/rvinecopulib author ecosystem (the Python counterpart being [[pyvinecopulib]]) and forms a copula toolchain with [[vinecopula-r]], [[copula-r]] and [[simcop]], connecting methodologically to [[insurance-copula]], [[insurance-vine-longitudinal]] (longitudinal vine copulas) and [[insurance-quantile]] (quantile methods); suits dependence modelling, tail risk and quantile pricing.

(2017)；底層依賴 rvinecopulib、kde1d 與 Rcpp。其定位是：**不建模條件均值，而是直接給出條件分位數**，並允許變量之間的相依結構隨協變量變化。對 RIAA：保險定價與風險度量真正關心的往往不是均值而是**條件分位數**（VaR、分位定價、高分位情景），而普通線性分位回歸在多變量、非線性、尾部相依的數據上不夠用——vinereg 把藤 Copula 的靈活性直接接到分位回歸上；它屬於 VineCopula/rvinecopulib 的作者生態（Python 側對應 [[pyvinecopulib]]），與 [[vinecopula-r]]、[[copula-r]]、[[simcop]] 構成 copula 工具鏈，與 [[insurance-copula]]、[[insurance-vine-longitudinal]]、[[insurance-quantile]] 在方法上直接對接；適合作相依建模、尾部風險與分位定價方向。
